biocontainers.name: mutscan
biocontainers.summary: Detect and visualize target mutations by scanning FastQ files directly

biotools.summary: Provides functionality for processing and statistical analysis of multiplexed assays of variant effect (MAVE) and similar data. The package contains functions covering the full workflow from raw FASTQ files to publication-ready visualizations. A broad range of library designs can be processed with a single, unified interface.
